audit.whatIsWrong: Chart read Skill/Akali/Akali/Skill/Skill/Akali/Akali. It disagreed with the packet chart (Akali levels 1-6, Yasuo at 2+ items) and with this page's own late text and whys[6], which both say Yasuo wins the late game. The diff enum also read EVEN while diffRating is 8.5/10 and report[14] calls it a hard matchup.
audit.why: Five Point Strike out-ranges Yasuo's 475 Q with no mana-style downtime (1.5s cooldown), and Twilight Shroud makes her unselectable, so she owns every lane phase; Yasuo only wins once crit items make his sustained DPS beat her cooldown-gated burst.
audit.corrected: Levels 1 through Level 6 read Akali; 2+ items reads Yasuo. diff set to HARD to match the 8.5/10 rating. Chart rows proposed as a matched full+content group.

audit.why: Spike windows are right: Akali at 3-5, at 6 with Perfect Execution (120/90/60s), and on her first AP item; Yasuo late on crit. Only the mechanics inside the spikes were wrong.
audit.corrected: Windows unchanged; spikes[0], spikes[1] and spikes[3] text corrected.

audit.whatIsWrong: Six places told the player to save Wind Wall for Perfect Execution's R2 recast: spikes[0] ('her R2 dash-recast'), spikes[1] ('Save Wind Wall for her R2 recast'), spikes[3] ('her Q, R2 line and E marker'), late ('R2 line'), mid ('hold Wind Wall for the R2 recast line'), wants.you[1]. spikes[0] also claimed Twilight Shroud gives her a shield.
audit.why: Riot flags Perfect Execution as a dash, not a projectile — Wind Wall does not stop it. The projectiles in her kit are Five Point Strike (Q) and the Shuriken Flip (E) shuriken; walling the E shuriken removes the mark and therefore her whole engage. Twilight Shroud grants invisibility and unselectability plus move speed, no shield.
audit.corrected: Wind Wall blocks Five Point Strike and the Shuriken Flip shuriken and never Perfect Execution; hold the 25s rank-1 wall for her Q and E. Shroud makes her untargetable, it does not shield her. Also added the Assassin's Mark auto-reset wind-up as the burst tell.

edits.before: Akali dominates this window: her Five Point Strike (Q) plus Twilight Shroud (W) lets her poke and reset the trade while you have no way to punish her in the smoke. Wind Wall can block her Q and, crucially, her R2 dash-recast, but she'll bait it. Farm with max-range Q and don't chase her into the shroud where she gains stealth and a shield.
edits.after: Akali dominates this window: her Five Point Strike (Q) plus Twilight Shroud (W) lets her poke and reset the trade while you have no way to punish her in the smoke. Wind Wall blocks Five Point Strike and Shuriken Flip's shuriken — a raised wall deletes her engage, not just her poke. Farm with max-range Q and don't chase her into the shroud where she is untargetable.

edits.before: Perfect Execution (R) is a two-part gap-close and execute; Akali all-ins you the second she's 6 and rewards any missed CS. Save Wind Wall for her R2 recast — the line of damage that finishes you — rather than blowing it on the initial jump.
edits.after: Perfect Execution (R) is a two-part gap-close and execute; Akali all-ins you the second she's 6 and rewards any missed CS. Wind Wall will not stop it — Perfect Execution is a dash, not a projectile — so hold your 25s wall for her Q and E instead.

edits.before: Yasuo pulls ahead once you have crit items and Wind Wall discipline: her burst combo is telegraphed and her Q, R2 line and E marker can all be eaten by the wall. Kite the shroud, hold W for her recast, and your sustained crit DPS beats her cooldown-gated burst.
edits.after: Yasuo pulls ahead once you have crit items and Wind Wall discipline: her Q and her E shuriken both die to the wall, so she cannot mark you and dash in. Kite the shroud, wall her engage, and your sustained crit DPS beats her cooldown-gated burst.

edits.before: With full crit items Yasuo flips it. Her burst is cooldown-gated and telegraphed, and Wind Wall eats her Q, E marker and R2 line. Kite the shroud, punish her cooldowns, and out-DPS her over a sustained fight.
edits.after: With full crit items Yasuo flips it. Her burst is cooldown-gated and telegraphed, and Wind Wall eats her Q and her E shuriken — but never her R dash. Kite the shroud, punish her cooldowns, and out-DPS her.

edits.before: Levels 3-6 are her kill window. Q plus Shroud controls the trade and R at 6 gives her a two-part gap-close execute. Respect her all-in, hold Wind Wall for the R2 recast line, and don't get caught low.
edits.after: Levels 3-6 are her kill window. Q plus Shroud controls the trade and R at 6 gives her a two-part gap-close execute. Respect her all-in, save Wind Wall for her Q and E, not her R.

edits.before: Bank Wind Wall for her R2 recast or Q line
edits.after: Bank Wind Wall for her Q and her E shuriken

edits.before: Dashing INTO his engage with passive shield down — the wave is your armor; off it you are the squishiest melee alive.
edits.after: Her empowered Assassin's Mark auto is the burst opener — step out of the ring's edge before she reaches you.
